entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I, uh, I need to return something. I bought some of your road cycling shoes a couple of weeks ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
Oh, it's not a fault. They're beautiful shoes. But they just... they don't fit my feet right. I went for one ride and they gave me terrible blisters. I haven't even installed the cleats or anything.
I'm sorry to hear they're causing you discomfort. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our riders. Let me just pull up your order information.
Okay. I just... I feel bad, but I really needed this money back. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I was so excited, but now I'm just disappointed and out the cash.
I completely understand. Let's see what we can do. Okay, I see the order here. It was delivered 18 days ago.
Is... is that a problem? I hope it's not too late.
Not at all. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for these cycling shoes for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, David. I was so worried.

Of course. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now. Just pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you again. You've really helped me out today.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
